accessibility.bannerText: Accessibility previews stay on this screen unless noted. No translation data leaves your device.
accessibility.previewAlertMessage: English is the only enabled product locale in this build. Kiswahili and Sheng require reviewed, versioned resources before they can be selected.
accessibility.languageDescription: English is enabled. Other listed languages remain unavailable until their full resource scope and safeguarding review are approved.
accessibility.languageFootnote: Kiswahili and Sheng are disabled. Existing partial strings are not a release-ready language pack.
accessibility.textSizeDescription: Adjust this preview to inspect readability. Full app text-size persistence is not wired in this build.
accessibility.previewBody: Use shake or secret taps while SafeRide is open. Nothing leaves your phone without consent.
accessibility.complianceGood: Preview meets AA at this size
accessibility.highContrastFootnote: This setting is saved on this device and applies throughout SafeRide.
accessibility.screenReaderDescription: See how items are announced with TalkBack.
accessibility.demoAnnouncement: Timeline item. Case created, two hours ago. Local only.
accessibility.screenReaderFootnote: We group related content and avoid icon-only controls.
accessibility.hapticsOffToast: Haptics are off in system settings
accessibility.hapticsFootnote: Haptics can be noticeable. Use with awareness.
accessibility.footerNote: English is the only enabled product locale. High contrast applies throughout SafeRide; text size here remains a preview of system font scaling.
accessibility.speechFallbackToastMessage: The preferred speech voice is not available on this device, so the demo used the default voice.

measurement.settingsMeta: Off unless an approved test build and separate consent are active
measurement.disabledBody: This build has no current approval for moderated-test measurement. No test events are recorded.
measurement.enabledBanner: Moderated-test measurement is enabled for this session
measurement.consentBody: With separate consent, SafeRide stores content-free task events on this device. It never stores incident narrative, evidence, exact location, contact details, sign-in data, or AI prompts and replies in test metrics.
measurement.issueBody: Choose categories only. Do not enter incident details; this form has no free-text field.
measurement.summaryBody: Inspect content-free events and categorical issues stored on this device. Nothing uploads automatically.
measurement.diagnosticsBody: Review the allowlisted app version, device tier, Android version, and feature flags before including them.
measurement.retention: Categorical issue reports are retained locally for at most 24 hours unless you delete them sooner.
measurement.assistanceBody: A completion is counted as unassisted only after the moderator explicitly marks this session. The default is not recorded.
measurement.noEvents: No current test events are stored.
measurement.noIssues: No current issue reports are stored.
measurement.saveFailed: Could not save local test data
measurement.loadFailed: Could not read local test data
measurement.confirmDeleteBody: This removes the selected test data from this device and cannot be undone.
